title: Canavarlar da Dünyayı Sever
author: Özlem Fedai Korçak
description: In this witty and heartwarming picture book, a group of misunderstood monsters protest the assumption that they don’t belong or that they don’t care about the planet. With humor and charm, they remind readers that the Earth is their home too, shared with billions of humans, animals, and plants. Through playful storytelling and lively, imaginative visuals, the book introduces child-friendly environmental actions such as saving water, recycling, composting, reducing waste, and protecting trees, while gently exploring themes of empathy, coexistence, and respect for all living beings. A funny, socially conscious story that empowers children to care for the Earth together.
